note: Five nested brightness contours as GeoJSON in equatorial degrees, rasterised here into an equirectangular luminance map. VECTOR rather than a photograph on purpose: the sky in this renderer is stylised, and a Brunier panorama would look like a photograph pasted behind a drawing. Contours give a soft band that sits with the stars.
